# The per-node input type spellings a DRIVER would supply from type inference.
# The generator derives none of them, so this table stands in for that step and
# the emitter instantiates what it names. One line per node in budget.flow.
#
# THIS FILE IS AN INPUT TO A PINNED PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENT, not documentation
# beside a golden. It and budget.flow are the whole of what TestGenerationBudget
# reads, both are covered by one digest over this directory, and a spelling
# lengthened here moves the generated output and therefore the timing. It moves
# only when the fixture does, and moving either means re-pinning the digest and
# recording a new baseline beside the old one.
